### Custom Cycling functions to account for batch, sex, pmi

```{r}

is_cycling_custom <- function(times, pb_mat, meta_data, time_units = "hrs") {
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  cat("\nRunning is_cycling()")
  
  gene1 = t(pb_mat)  # transpose: subjects x genes
  
  if (time_units == "hrs") {
    cat("\nConverting hours to radians")
    times1 = times / 12 * pi
  } else {
    cat("\nAssuming times are already in radians (0–2π)")
    times1 = times
  }
  
  batches = meta_data$batch_bin[match(colnames(pb_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.factor()
  pmi = meta_data$pmi[match(colnames(pb_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.numeric()
  sex = meta_data$sex[match(colnames(pb_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.factor()
  
  has_batches <- nlevels(batches) > 1
  cat(paste0("\nDetected ", nlevels(batches), " batch levels; ",
             ifelse(has_batches, "including batch in model.", "excluding batch.")))
  
  all_genes = foreach(gene_i = 1:ncol(gene1), .combine = rbind) %do% {
    gexp1 = as.numeric(unlist(gene1[, gene_i]))
    Gene_Symbols = colnames(gene1)[gene_i]
    
    # Skip genes with no variance
    if (all(gexp1 == 0) || sd(gexp1) == 0) {
      return(c(Gene_Symbols, rep(NA, 12)))
    }
    
    if (has_batches) {
      partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ batches + pmi + sex)
      full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1) + batches + pmi + sex)
      design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1) + batches + pmi + sex)
    } else {
      partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ pmi + sex)
      full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1) + pmi + sex)
      design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1) + pmi + sex)
    }
    
    anova_results = anova(partial_model, full_model)
    sin_coff = full_model$coefficients[["sin(times1)"]]
    cos_coeff = full_model$coefficients[["cos(times1)"]]
    acrophase_bulk = atan2(sin_coff, cos_coeff) %% (2 * pi)
    amplitude_bulk = sqrt(sin_coff^2 + cos_coeff^2)
    p_statistic = anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2]
    mesor_bulk = mean(design_matrix[, -c(2, 3)] %*% full_model$coefficients[-c(2, 3)])
    amp_ratio = amplitude_bulk / mesor_bulk
    
    partial_model_AIC = AIC(partial_model)
    full_model_AIC = AIC(full_model)
    partial_model_BIC = BIC(partial_model)
    full_model_BIC = BIC(full_model)
    
    pb_batch_coeff = if (has_batches) {
      full_model$coefficients[grep("batches", names(full_model$coefficients))]
      }else{
      NA
    }
    
    cbind(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk, amplitude_bulk, p_statistic, amp_ratio,
          sin_coff, cos_coeff, mesor_bulk,
          partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC, partial_model_BIC, full_model_BIC, pb_batch_coeff)
  }
  
  all_genes = as_tibble(all_genes) %>% drop_na(-pb_batch_coeff)
  all_genes$BHQ = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$p_statistic), "BH")
  all_genes$Bonf = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$p_statistic), "bonferroni")
  return(all_genes)
}

var_cycling_custom <- function(times, var_mat, mean_mat, phase_pb, meta_data, time_units = "hrs") {
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  cat("\nRunning var_cycling()")
  
  gene1 = t(var_mat)
  means1 = t(mean_mat)
  
  if (time_units == "hrs") {
    cat("\nConverting hours to radians")
    times1 = times / 12 * pi
  } else {
    cat("\nAssuming times are already in radians (0–2π)")
    times1 = times
  }
  
  batches = meta_data$batch_bin[match(colnames(mean_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.factor()
  pmi = meta_data$pmi[match(colnames(mean_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.numeric()
  sex = meta_data$sex[match(colnames(mean_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.factor()
  
  has_batches <- nlevels(batches) > 1
  cat(paste0("\nDetected ", nlevels(batches), " batch levels; ",
             ifelse(has_batches, "including batch in model.", "excluding batch.")))
  
  all_genes = foreach(gene_i = 1:ncol(gene1), .combine = rbind) %do% {
    gexp1 = as.numeric(unlist(gene1[, gene_i]))
    m1 = as.numeric(unlist(means1[, gene_i]))
    Gene_Symbols = colnames(gene1)[gene_i]
    phase_bulk = as.numeric(phase_pb[gene_i])
    
    if (all(m1 == 0) || all(gexp1 == 0) || sd(m1) == 0 || sd(gexp1) == 0) {
      return(c(Gene_Symbols, rep(NA, 12)))
    }
    
    if (has_batches) {
      partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ m1 + batches + pmi + sex)
      full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times1) + cos(2 * times1) + m1 + batches + pmi + sex)
      design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times1) + cos(2 * times1) + m1 + batches + pmi + sex)
    } else {
      partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ m1 + pmi + sex)
      full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times1) + cos(2 * times1) + m1 + pmi + sex)
      design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(2 * times1) + cos(2 * times1) + m1 + pmi + sex)
    }
    
    anova_results = anova(partial_model, full_model)
    sin_coff = full_model$coefficients[["sin(2 * times1)"]]
    cos_coeff = full_model$coefficients[["cos(2 * times1)"]]
    double_freq_acrophase = atan2(sin_coff, cos_coeff) %% (2 * pi) / 2
    
    find_Af = if (has_batches){
      lm(full_model$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1 ~ cos(times1) + sin(times1) + batches + pmi + sex)
    }else{
      lm(full_model$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1 ~ cos(times1) + sin(times1) + pmi + sex)
    }
      
    fund_amp = sqrt(find_Af$coefficients[["sin(times1)"]]^2 +
                    find_Af$coefficients[["cos(times1)"]]^2)
    fund_acro = atan2(find_Af$coefficients[["sin(times1)"]],
                      find_Af$coefficients[["cos(times1)"]]) %% (2 * pi)
    
    double_freq_p_statistic = anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2]
    raw_2w_amp = sqrt(sin_coff^2 + cos_coeff^2)
    double_freq_amplitude = -cos_coeff * cos(2 * phase_bulk) - sin_coff * sin(2 * phase_bulk)
    var_mesor = mean(design_matrix[, -c(2, 3)] %*% full_model$coefficients[-c(2, 3)])
    
    partial_model_AIC = AIC(partial_model)
    full_model_AIC = AIC(full_model)
    partial_model_BIC = BIC(partial_model)
    full_model_BIC = BIC(full_model)
    
    var_batch_coeff = if (has_batches) {
      full_model$coefficients[grep("batches", names(full_model$coefficients))]
      }else{
      NA
    }
    
    cbind(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_acrophase, double_freq_amplitude,
          double_freq_p_statistic, fund_amp, fund_acro, var_mesor,
          partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC, partial_model_BIC, full_model_BIC, raw_2w_amp, var_batch_coeff)
  }
  
  all_genes = as_tibble(all_genes) %>% drop_na(-var_batch_coeff)
  all_genes$BHQ = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$double_freq_p_statistic), "BH")
  all_genes$Bonf = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$double_freq_p_statistic), "bonferroni")
  return(all_genes)
}

var_cycling_custom_fixed_acro <- function(times, var_mat, mean_mat, phase_pb, meta_data, time_units = "hrs") {
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  cat("\nRunning var_cycling_fixed_acro()")
  
  gene1 = t(var_mat)
  means1 = t(mean_mat)
  
  if (time_units == "hrs") {
    cat("\nConverting hours to radians")
    times1 = times / 12 * pi
  } else {
    cat("\nAssuming times are already in radians (0–2π)")
    times1 = times
  }
  
  batches = meta_data$batch_bin[match(colnames(mean_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.factor()
  pmi = meta_data$pmi[match(colnames(mean_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.numeric()
  sex = meta_data$sex[match(colnames(mean_mat), meta_data$individualID)] %>%
    unname() %>% unlist() %>% as.factor()
  
  has_batches <- nlevels(batches) > 1
  cat(paste0("\nDetected ", nlevels(batches), " batch levels; ",
             ifelse(has_batches, "including batch in model.", "excluding batch.")))
  
  all_genes = foreach(gene_i = 1:ncol(gene1), .combine = rbind) %do% {
    gexp1 = as.numeric(unlist(gene1[, gene_i]))
    m1 = as.numeric(unlist(means1[, gene_i]))
    Gene_Symbols = colnames(gene1)[gene_i]
    phase_bulk = as.numeric(phase_pb[gene_i])
    
    if (all(m1 == 0) || all(gexp1 == 0) || sd(m1) == 0 || sd(gexp1) == 0) {
      return(c(Gene_Symbols, rep(NA, 10)))
    }
    double_wave = cos(2 * (times1- pi/2 - phase_bulk))

    if (has_batches) {
      partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ m1 + batches + pmi + sex)
      full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1 + batches + pmi + sex)
      design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1 + batches + pmi + sex)
    } else {
      partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ m1 + pmi + sex)
      full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1 + pmi + sex)
      design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ double_wave + m1 + pmi + sex)
    }
    
    anova_results = anova(partial_model, full_model)
    
    
    find_Af = if (has_batches){
      lm(full_model$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1 ~ cos(times1-phase_bulk) + batches + pmi + sex)
    }else{
      lm(full_model$coefficients[["m1"]] * m1 ~ cos(times1-phase_bulk) + pmi + sex)
    }
    fund_mean_coeff = full_model$coefficients[["m1"]]
    fund_amp = find_Af$coefficients[["cos(times1 - phase_bulk)"]]
    
    double_freq_p_statistic = anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2]
    double_freq_amplitude = full_model$coefficients[["double_wave"]]
    var_mesor = mean(design_matrix[,-2] %*% full_model[["coefficients"]][-2])
    
    partial_model_AIC = AIC(partial_model)
    full_model_AIC = AIC(full_model)
    partial_model_BIC = BIC(partial_model)
    full_model_BIC = BIC(full_model)
    
     var_batch_coeff = if (has_batches) {
      full_model$coefficients[grep("batches", names(full_model$coefficients))]
      }else{
      NA
    }
    
    cbind(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,
          double_freq_p_statistic, fund_amp, var_mesor,
          partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC, partial_model_BIC, full_model_BIC, fund_mean_coeff, var_batch_coeff)
  }
  
  all_genes = as_tibble(all_genes) %>% drop_na(-var_batch_coeff)
  all_genes$BHQ = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$double_freq_p_statistic), "BH")
  all_genes$Bonf = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$double_freq_p_statistic), "bonferroni")
  return(all_genes)
}
```

### Run ORPHEUS for each group with custom cycling functions

```{r}
#In this loop I will need meta.data from s_obj, first I need to make sure all the times, batch_bin, and pmi, sex are equal among individual_ID:
# s_obj@meta.data %>%
#   group_by(individualID) %>%
#   summarise(
#     across(c(batch_bin, sex, pmi, times, cond_cogdx), ~n_distinct(.x))
#   )

#Since assumption is correct, this code below correctly gets metadata for each subject:
# subject_meta <- s_obj@meta.data %>%
#   group_by(individualID) %>%
#   summarise(
#     batch_bin = first(batch_bin),
#     sex = first(sex),
#     pmi = first(pmi),
#     times = first(times),
#     cond = first(cond_cogdx)
#   )
# save(subject_meta, file = "./figures/rosmap_exc35/subject_meta_cogdx.RData")
load("./figures/rosmap_exc35/subject_meta_cogdx.RData")

cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(orpheus_inputs)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing condition", cell_type))


tmp = orpheus_inputs[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
colnames(time_wise_theta_meas) = paste0(colnames(time_wise_theta_meas), "_theta_meas")

vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)



# times = s_obj$times[match(colnames(pb_mat), s_obj$individualID)] %>% unname %>% unlist
meta_data <- subject_meta[match(colnames(pb_mat), subject_meta$individualID), ]
times = meta_data$times
# stopifnot(all.equal(times, meta_data$times))


pb_cycling_custom = is_cycling_custom(times, pb_mat, meta_data, time_units = "rads")
# write.table(pb_cycling_custom, paste0("~/Desktop/pb_cycling_results_",cell_type, ".csv" ), sep = ",", row.names = F)

stopifnot(all(pb_cycling_custom$Gene_Symbols == rownames(var_mat)))
pb_phases_cust = as.numeric(pb_cycling_custom$acrophase_bulk)

var_cyclers_cust = var_cycling_custom_fixed_acro(times, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = pb_phases_cust, meta_data = meta_data, time_units = "rads")

# plot_rhythms(times, var_mat, pb_mat, plot_me = c("RPS28", "ATP6V0C"), time_units = "rads", line_color = "black", point_color = "skyblue", point_size = 2)

bulk_thr_cutoff = 0.5

input_cos_cust = var_cyclers_cust %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling_custom, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix = c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    #mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk,  everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

# Calculate phi parameters
phi_cust = input_cos_cust %>%
    apply(., 1, function(row) {
        suppressWarnings(
             Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
             )
    }) %>%
    t %>%
    as.data.frame
colnames(phi_cust) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")

output_cust = merge(phi_cust, input_cos_cust, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output_cust)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}


```

### Combine results into single df

```{r}
cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))
```

### enrichR:

```{r}
library(enrichR)
websiteLive <- getOption("enrichR.live")

dbs <- c("MSigDB_Hallmark_2020", "GO_Biological_Process_2023", "Reactome_2022", "KEGG_2021_Human")


AD_phis = read.delim("./figures/rosmap_exc35/rnk/rosmap_exc35_ADphi.rnk", header = F) 
CTL_phis = read.delim("./figures/rosmap_exc35/rnk/rosmap_exc35_CTLphi.rnk", header = F)
CTLminusAD = read.delim("./figures/rosmap_exc35/rnk/rosmap_exc35_ctlPhiMinusADPhi.rnk", header = F)

run_enrichR = function(phi_df, dbs, prop = 0.5){
  websiteLive <- getOption("enrichR.live")
  
  top_frac = arrange(phi_df, V2) %>% slice_head(prop = prop) %>% select(V1) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  bottom_frac = arrange(phi_df, V2) %>% slice_tail(prop = prop) %>% select(V1) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  background = phi_df %>% select(V1) %>% unname %>% unlist
  
  if (websiteLive) {
      # Replace 'Rank' with 'Overlap' column, calculated with GMT files
      synchronized<- enrichr(top_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      synchronized_df = do.call(rbind, synchronized) %>% arrange(P.value)
      synchronized_df$group = "synch"
      unsynch <-enrichr(bottom_frac, dbs, background = background, include_overlap = TRUE)
      unsynch_df = do.call(rbind, unsynch) %>% arrange(P.value)
      unsynch_df$group = "unsynch"

     return(rbind(synchronized_df, unsynch_df))
  }
  
}

AD_phis_enrichR = run_enrichR(AD_phis, dbs, prop = 0.3)
CTL_phis_enrichR = run_enrichR(CTL_phis,dbs,  prop = 0.3)
CTLminusAD_phis_enrichR = run_enrichR(CTLminusAD, dbs, prop = 0.3)

```

### Create acrophase histograms by finding significant 24hr and 12hr rhythms without priors about where they should be:

```{r}
load("./figures/rosmap_exc35/subject_meta_cogdx.RData")

free_acro_res = list()
for(cell_type in names(orpheus_inputs)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing condition", cell_type))

tmp = orpheus_inputs[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

# times = s_obj$times[match(colnames(pb_mat), s_obj$individualID)] %>% unname %>% unlist
meta_data <- subject_meta[match(colnames(pb_mat), subject_meta$individualID), ]
#stopifnot(all.equal(times, meta_data$times))
times = meta_data$times

pb_cycling_custom = is_cycling_custom(times, pb_mat, meta_data, time_units = "rads")

stopifnot(all(pb_cycling_custom$Gene_Symbols == rownames(var_mat)))
pb_phases_cust = as.numeric(pb_cycling_custom$acrophase_bulk)

var_cyclers_cust = var_cycling_custom(times, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = pb_phases_cust, meta_data = meta_data, time_units = "rads")

bulk_thr_cutoff = 0.5

input_cos_cust = var_cyclers_cust %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling_custom, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix = c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk,  everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)



local_res =  list("tmm" = input_cos_cust)
names(local_res) = cell_type
free_acro_res <- append(free_acro_res, list(local_res))
}

free_acro_res_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(free_acro_res), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- free_acro_res[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(free_acro_res[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

color_palette <- c("0" = "skyblue", "1" = "salmon")

acrodiff_compare = ggplot(free_acro_res_combined, aes(x = acrodiff*12/pi, fill = Source)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, color = "black", alpha = 1,  breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 2)) +
  facet_wrap(~ as.factor(Source), scales = "free_y", labeller = as_labeller(c("0" = "CTL", "1" = "AD"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  guides(fill = "none") +    # remove fill legend
  xlab("Fundamental vs 2nd harmonic of variance\n absolute acrophase diff. (hrs)")+
  ylab("Count")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase x-axis text size
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)    # Increase legend title size
  )+
   # Use scale_x_continuous for precise control over the x-axis
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 12),
    breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 3)
  )
ggsave("~/Desktop/exc25_acrodiff_compare_Dec9.pdf", plot = acrodiff_compare, device = "pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r}
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)

rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)



# times = s_obj$times[match(colnames(pb_mat), s_obj$individualID)] %>% unname %>% unlist
```

```{r}
load("./figures/rosmap_exc35/Braaksc/exc35_braak_pb_var_list.RData")
load("./figures/rosmap_exc35/subject_meta_cogdx.RData")


cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(orpheus_inputs)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing condition", cell_type))


tmp = orpheus_inputs[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
colnames(time_wise_theta_meas) = paste0(colnames(time_wise_theta_meas), "_theta_meas")

vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)



# times = s_obj$times[match(colnames(pb_mat), s_obj$individualID)] %>% unname %>% unlist
meta_data <- subject_meta[match(colnames(pb_mat), subject_meta$individualID), ]
#stopifnot(all.equal(times, meta_data$times))
times = meta_data$times

pb_cycling_custom = is_cycling_custom(times, pb_mat, meta_data, time_units = "rads")
# write.table(pb_cycling_custom, paste0("~/Desktop/pb_cycling_results_",cell_type, ".csv" ), sep = ",", row.names = F)

stopifnot(all(pb_cycling_custom$Gene_Symbols == rownames(var_mat)))
pb_phases_cust = as.numeric(pb_cycling_custom$acrophase_bulk)

var_cyclers_cust = var_cycling_custom_fixed_acro(times, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = pb_phases_cust, meta_data = meta_data, time_units = "rads")

bulk_thr_cutoff = 0.5

input_cos_cust = var_cyclers_cust %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling_custom, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix = c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk,  everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

# Calculate phi parameters
phi_cust = input_cos_cust %>%
    apply(., 1, function(row) {
        suppressWarnings(
             Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
             )
    }) %>%
    t %>%
    as.data.frame
colnames(phi_cust) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")

output_cust = merge(phi_cust, input_cos_cust, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output_cust)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}

  current_df
}))
```

#### load normed counts for gsva, calculated above:

```{r}
load("../../figures/rosmap_exc35/exc35_logcpm_pseudobulk_for_gsva.RData")
```

#### Get pathways for gsva

```{r}

# human_hallmark <- msigdbr(db_species = "HS", species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
# genesets_list <- split(human_hallmark$gene_symbol, human_hallmark$gs_name)

human_kegg <- msigdbr(db_species = "HS", species = "Homo sapiens",
                      collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY")
genesets_list <- split(human_kegg$gene_symbol, human_kegg$gs_name)
```

#### Read in cycling (in AD and CTL) results (genes with significance values).

```{r}
AD_cycling_results = read_csv("./figures/rosmap_exc35/cycling_results/cosinor_results_AD.csv", show_col_types = F)

AD_non_cyclers = dplyr::filter(AD_cycling_results, as.numeric(BHQ) >= 0.1 & as.numeric(amp_ratio) < 0.1 )

CTL_cycling_results = read_csv("./figures/rosmap_exc35/cycling_results/cosinor_results_CTL.csv", show_col_types = F)

CTL_non_cyclers = dplyr::filter(CTL_cycling_results, as.numeric(BHQ) >= 0.1 & as.numeric(amp_ratio) < 0.1) 

```

#### For Orpheus, we normalize raw counts again in the method ORPHEUS prefers, and this is done with all cells present. Read in saved data for speed.

```{r}
#Perform Orpheus normalization for all cells in combined:
# s_obj = prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(seurat_obj = s_obj, assay = "RNA" )

# SaveH5Seurat(s_obj, "../../figures/rosmap_exc35/exc35_ctl_ad_combined_w_Orpheus_norm_layer.h5Seurat", overwrite = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)

file = c("../../figures/rosmap_exc35/exc35_ctl_ad_combined_w_Orpheus_norm_layer.h5Seurat")
s_obj = LoadH5Seurat(file,assays = c("ORPHEUS_norm"), reductions = F, graphs = F, neighbors = F, images = F)

subject_meta <- s_obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(individualID) %>%
  summarise(
    batch_bin = first(batch_bin),
    sex = first(sex),
    pmi = first(pmi),
    times = first(times),
    cond = first(cond_cogdx)
  )

```

#### GSVA pathway analysis for CTL cells

```{r}
#convert logged PB counts to a df
df_logcpm_pseudobulk = as.data.frame(logcpm_pseudobulk)

#Grab the CTL subjects, and the non-rhythmic genes
exc35_CTL_tmm_non_rhythmic = df_logcpm_pseudobulk[CTL_non_cyclers$Gene_Symbols, subject_meta$individualID[subject_meta$cond == 0]]
  
#Call GSVA, ranking CTL subjects by pathway score for all pathways
gsva_res_ctl = gsva(as.matrix(exc35_CTL_tmm_non_rhythmic), genesets_list) %>% as.data.frame

# Create a list to store results
pathway_groups_ctl <- apply(gsva_res_ctl, 1, function(scores) {
  med <- median(scores, na.rm = TRUE)   # median as threshold
  ifelse(scores >= med, "high", "low")
})

#Join subject metadata to pathway score information
pathway_w_meta_ctl = merge(pathway_groups_ctl, subject_meta, by.x = 0, by.y= "individualID") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "Row.names")

#subset s_obj to have only CTL cells:
s_ctl <- subset(s_obj, subset = cond_cogdx == 0)
table(s_ctl$cond_cogdx)
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# load("../../figures/rosmap_exc35/exc35_ctl_pb_var_matrices_list.RData")
load("./figures/rosmap_exc35/exc35_ctl_pb_var_matrices_list_KEGG.RData")
load("./figures/rosmap_exc35/subject_meta_cogdx.RData")
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Now for each pathway, we look at the high and low groups:
phi_outputs = list()
for(pathway_name in names(pb_var_list)){

orpheus_input_i = pb_var_list[[pathway_name]]
#---------------BEGIN new technique: cycling together--------------------  
# run cycling on the high and low groups together (concatenated pseudobulk, etc.) to find which genes I will test by my normal cutoffs, then do Orpheus for those genes without any cutoffs.
pb_combined  <- cbind(orpheus_input_i$high$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix, orpheus_input_i$low$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix)

var_combined <- cbind(orpheus_input_i$high$var_df, orpheus_input_i$low$var_df)


# times_combined = s_ctl$times[match(colnames(pb_combined), s_ctl$individualID)] %>% unname %>% unlist
meta_data_combined <- subject_meta[match(colnames(pb_combined), subject_meta$individualID), ]
meta_data_combined$group = c(rep("high",
      ncol(orpheus_input_i$high$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix)),
      rep("low",ncol(orpheus_input_i$low$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix) ))
times_combined = meta_data_combined$times

pb_cycling = is_cycling_custom(times_combined, pb_combined, meta_data = meta_data_combined, time_units = "rad")

pb_cycling_filt = filter(pb_cycling, as.numeric(amp_ratio) >=0.20 & as.numeric(BHQ) < 0.1)

pb_phases = as.numeric(unname(unlist(pb_cycling_filt$acrophase_bulk)))

#Subset the pseudobulk and variance matrices so I can save time not running var_cycling on non-cycling genes.
pb_combined_subset = pb_combined[pb_cycling_filt$Gene_Symbols,]
var_combined_subset = var_combined[pb_cycling_filt$Gene_Symbols,]
stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(pb_combined_subset), rownames(var_combined_subset)))

var_cyclers = var_cycling_custom_fixed_acro(times = times_combined, 
    var_mat = var_combined_subset,
    mean_mat = pb_combined_subset,    
    phase_pb =  pb_phases,
    meta_data = meta_data_combined,
    time_units = "rad")


#Which genes should I extract a phi from?
bulk_thr_cutoff = 0.5  

keep_genes = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var","_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var) %>%
    select(Gene_Symbols) %>%
    unname %>%
    unlist

#---------------END new technique: cycling together--------------------  
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(orpheus_input_i)){
print(paste("Analyzing condition", cell_type))
tmp = orpheus_input_i[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
# times = s_ctl$times[match(colnames(pb_mat), s_ctl$individualID)] %>% unname %>% unlist
meta_data <- subject_meta[match(colnames(pb_mat), subject_meta$individualID), ]
times = meta_data$times
# stopifnot(all.equal(times, meta_data$times))
stopifnot(all(meta_data$cond == 0)) #Are all subjects ctl?

pb_mat_keep = pb_mat[keep_genes, ]
var_mat_keep = var_mat[keep_genes, ]

stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(pb_mat_keep), rownames(var_mat_keep)))

pb_cycling_custom = is_cycling_custom(times, pb_mat_keep, meta_data, time_units = "rads")
# write.table(pb_cycling_custom, paste0("~/Desktop/pb_cycling_results_",cell_type, ".csv" ), sep = ",", row.names = F)

stopifnot(all.equal(pb_cycling_custom$Gene_Symbols , rownames(var_mat_keep)))
pb_phases_cust = as.numeric(pb_cycling_custom$acrophase_bulk)

var_cyclers_cust = var_cycling_custom_fixed_acro(times, var_mat = var_mat_keep, mean_mat = pb_mat_keep, phase_pb = pb_phases_cust, meta_data = meta_data, time_units = "rads")


input_cos_cust = var_cyclers_cust %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling_custom, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix = c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    # filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk,  everything()) %>%
    filter(Gene_Symbols %in% keep_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")
    # filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    # column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    # filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

# Calculate phi parameters
phi_cust = input_cos_cust %>%
    apply(., 1, function(row) {
        suppressWarnings(
             Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
             )
    }) %>%
    t %>%
    as.data.frame
colnames(phi_cust) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")

output_cust = merge(phi_cust, input_cos_cust, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output_cust)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}

#Combine 'low' and 'high' groups
phi_results_i <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

#----- plotting ------
jitter_width <- 0.15
jitter_seed <- 123 # A specific seed for reproducibility
color_palette <- c("high" = "deepskyblue", "low" = "orange")

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(phi_results_i, aes(x = Source, y = phi*12/pi, fill = Source)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(
  aes(x = Source, y = phi*12/pi), 
  alpha = 0.4,
  position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
  ) +
  # Manually set the colors for fill and color aesthetics
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) +
  #Significance bar
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",         # Specify the statistical test
    comparisons = list(c("high", "low")), # A list of the pairs to compare
    label = "p.signif",             # Display significance levels
    label.y = 7, # Adjust vertical position of the bar
    tip.length = 0.02 # Length of the small vertical lines
  ) +
  # Add labels and a title
  labs(
    title = pathway_name,
    y = "Phase Dispersion (hrs)",
    x = "Pathway stratification"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # The x-axis labels are sufficient
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )+
  ylim(c(0,8))
#print(p)
ggsave(paste0("~/Desktop/rosmap_exc35_pathways_ctl/exc35_phi_boxplot",pathway_name,".pdf"),p, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 5 )

phi_output_i =  list("tmm" = phi_results_i)
names(phi_output_i) = pathway_name
phi_outputs <- append(phi_outputs, phi_output_i)

}

all_pathway_phis_df <- imap_dfr(phi_outputs, ~ mutate(.x, Source = .y))


save(phi_outputs, file = "~/Desktop/rosmap_exc35_pathways_ctl/rosmap_exc35_ctl_pathway_phis.RData")
save(all_pathway_phis_df, file = "~/Desktop/rosmap_exc35_pathways_ctl/rosmap_exc35_ctl_pathway_phis_df.RData")
```

```{r}
#Grab the AD subjects, and the non-rhythmic genes
exc35_AD_tmm_non_rhythmic = df_logcpm_pseudobulk[AD_non_cyclers$Gene_Symbols, subject_meta$individualID[subject_meta$cond == 1]]
  
#Call GSVA, ranking AD subjects by pathway score for all pathways
gsva_res_ad = gsva(as.matrix(exc35_AD_tmm_non_rhythmic), genesets_list) %>% as.data.frame

# Create a list to store results
pathway_groups_ad <- apply(gsva_res_ad, 1, function(scores) {
  med <- median(scores, na.rm = TRUE)   # median as threshold
  ifelse(scores >= med, "high", "low")
})

#Join subject metadata to pathway score information
pathway_w_meta_ad = merge(pathway_groups_ad, subject_meta, by.x = 0, by.y= "individualID") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "Row.names")

#subset s_obj to have only AD cells:
s_ad <- subset(s_obj, subset = cond_cogdx == 1)
table(s_ad$cond_cogdx)
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Loop through all the pathways and create pb and variance matrices for each,
#We will store these so I only have to do it once.

# pb_var_list = list()
# for(i in 1:ncol(pathway_groups_ad)){
# 
# pathway_name = colnames(pathway_w_meta_ad)[i]
# message("Analyzing ", pathway_name)
# 
# subject_strat = pathway_w_meta_ad[,i]
# times_split = split(pathway_w_meta_ad$times, subject_strat)
# test <- list(high = circular(times_split$high,
#                  units="radians"),
#   low = circular(times_split$low,
#                      units="radians")
# )
# ww_test_res = circular::watson.wheeler.test(test)
# if(ww_test_res$p.value < 0.05){
#    message(pathway_name , " ww_test < 0.05, skipping.")
#    next # Skips the rest of the current iteration
# }
# 
# # Add the new metadata to the Seurat object
# stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pathway_w_meta_ad$Row.names))
# s_ad$strat <- pathway_w_meta_ad[match(s_ad$orig.ident, rownames(pathway_w_meta_ad)), i]
# table(s_ad$strat, useNA = "ifany")
# 
# orpheus_input_i = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_ad, groups_to_analyze = c("high", "low"), grouping_var = "strat")
# 
# orpheus_input_sans_counts <- lapply(orpheus_input_i, function(x) x[-3])
# input_i =  list("tmm" = orpheus_input_sans_counts)
# names(input_i) = pathway_name
# pb_var_list <- append(pb_var_list, input_i)
# 
# }
# 
# save(pb_var_list, file ="figures/rosmap_exc35/exc35_ad_pb_var_matrices_list_KEGG.RData")
load("../../figures/rosmap_exc35/exc35_ad_pb_var_matrices_list.RData")
load("./figures/rosmap_exc35/subject_meta_cogdx.RData")
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Now for each pathway, we look at the high and low groups:
phi_outputs = list()
for(pathway_name in names(pb_var_list)){

orpheus_input_i = pb_var_list[[pathway_name]]
#---------------BEGIN new technique: cycling together--------------------  
# run cycling on the high and low groups together (concatenated pseudobulk, etc.) to find which genes I will test by my normal cutoffs, then do Orpheus for those genes without any cutoffs.
pb_combined  <- cbind(orpheus_input_i$high$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix, orpheus_input_i$low$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix)

var_combined <- cbind(orpheus_input_i$high$var_df, orpheus_input_i$low$var_df)



meta_data_combined <- subject_meta[match(colnames(pb_combined), subject_meta$individualID), ]
meta_data_combined$group = c(rep("high",
      ncol(orpheus_input_i$high$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix)),
      rep("low",ncol(orpheus_input_i$low$pseudobulk_tmm_matrix) ))
times_combined = meta_data_combined$times

pb_cycling = is_cycling_custom(times_combined, pb_combined, meta_data = meta_data_combined, time_units = "rad")

pb_cycling_filt = filter(pb_cycling, as.numeric(amp_ratio) >=0.20 & as.numeric(BHQ) < 0.1)

pb_phases = as.numeric(unname(unlist(pb_cycling_filt$acrophase_bulk)))

#Subset the pseudobulk and variance matrices so I can save time not running var_cycling on non-cycling genes.
pb_combined_subset = pb_combined[pb_cycling_filt$Gene_Symbols,]
var_combined_subset = var_combined[pb_cycling_filt$Gene_Symbols,]
stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(pb_combined_subset), rownames(var_combined_subset)))

var_cyclers = var_cycling_custom_fixed_acro(times = times_combined, 
    var_mat = var_combined_subset,
    mean_mat = pb_combined_subset,    
    phase_pb =  pb_phases,
    meta_data = meta_data_combined,
    time_units = "rad")


#Which genes should I extract a phi from?
bulk_thr_cutoff = 0.5  

keep_genes = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var","_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var) %>%
    select(Gene_Symbols) %>%
    unname %>%
    unlist

#---------------END new technique: cycling together--------------------  
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(orpheus_input_i)){
print(paste("Analyzing condition", cell_type))
tmp = orpheus_input_i[[cell_type]]
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]

meta_data <- subject_meta[match(colnames(pb_mat), subject_meta$individualID), ]
times = meta_data$times
# stopifnot(all.equal(times, meta_data$times))
stopifnot(all(meta_data$cond == 1)) #Are all subjects AD?

pb_mat_keep = pb_mat[keep_genes, ]
var_mat_keep = var_mat[keep_genes, ]

stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(pb_mat_keep), rownames(var_mat_keep)))

pb_cycling_custom = is_cycling_custom(times, pb_mat_keep, meta_data, time_units = "rads")
# write.table(pb_cycling_custom, paste0("~/Desktop/pb_cycling_results_",cell_type, ".csv" ), sep = ",", row.names = F)

stopifnot(all.equal(pb_cycling_custom$Gene_Symbols , rownames(var_mat_keep)))
pb_phases_cust = as.numeric(pb_cycling_custom$acrophase_bulk)

var_cyclers_cust = var_cycling_custom_fixed_acro(times, var_mat = var_mat_keep, mean_mat = pb_mat_keep, phase_pb = pb_phases_cust, meta_data = meta_data, time_units = "rads")


input_cos_cust = var_cyclers_cust %>%
    left_join(pb_cycling_custom, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix = c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    # filter(BHQ_pb < 0.1 & amp_ratio >= 0.2) %>%
    # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk,  everything()) %>%
    filter(Gene_Symbols %in% keep_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")
    # filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_thr_cutoff) %>%
    # column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    # filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

# Calculate phi parameters
phi_cust = input_cos_cust %>%
    apply(., 1, function(row) {
        suppressWarnings(
             Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
             )
    }) %>%
    t %>%
    as.data.frame
colnames(phi_cust) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")

output_cust = merge(phi_cust, input_cos_cust, by = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output_cust)
names(local_res) = cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}

#Combine 'low' and 'high' groups
phi_results_i <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

#----- plotting ------
jitter_width <- 0.15
jitter_seed <- 123 # A specific seed for reproducibility
color_palette <- c("high" = "deepskyblue", "low" = "orange")

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(phi_results_i, aes(x = Source, y = phi*12/pi, fill = Source)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(
  aes(x = Source, y = phi*12/pi), 
  alpha = 0.4,
  position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
  ) +
  # Manually set the colors for fill and color aesthetics
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) +
  #Significance bar
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",         # Specify the statistical test
    comparisons = list(c("high", "low")), # A list of the pairs to compare
    label = "p.signif",             # Display significance levels
    label.y = 7, # Adjust vertical position of the bar
    tip.length = 0.02 # Length of the small vertical lines
  ) +
  # Add labels and a title
  labs(
    title = pathway_name,
    y = "Phase Dispersion (hrs)",
    x = "Pathway stratification"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # The x-axis labels are sufficient
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )+
  ylim(c(0,8))
#print(p)
ggsave(paste0("~/Desktop/rosmap_exc35_pathways_ad/exc35_phi_boxplot",pathway_name,".pdf"),p, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 5 )

phi_output_i =  list("tmm" = phi_results_i)
names(phi_output_i) = pathway_name
phi_outputs <- append(phi_outputs, phi_output_i)

}

all_pathway_phis_df <- imap_dfr(phi_outputs, ~ mutate(.x, Source = .y))


save(phi_outputs, file = "~/Desktop/rosmap_exc35_pathways_ad/rosmap_exc35_ad_pathway_phis.RData")
save(all_pathway_phis_df, file = "~/Desktop/rosmap_exc35_pathways_ad/rosmap_exc35_ad_pathway_phis_df.RData")
```

### Repeat Main analysis but running is_cycling and var_cycling on AD and CTL subjects together using custom_function_method2 above:

```{r}

library(SeuratDisk)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
file = c("../../figures/rosmap_exc35/exc35_ctl_ad_combined_w_Orpheus_norm_layer.h5Seurat")
s_obj = LoadH5Seurat(file,assays = c("ORPHEUS_norm"), reductions = F, graphs = F, neighbors = F, images = F)

subject_meta <- s_obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(individualID) %>%
  summarise(
    batch_bin = first(batch_bin),
    sex = first(sex),
    pmi = first(pmi),
    times = first(times),
    cond = first(cond_cogdx)
  )
```

```{r}
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------

#---------------BEGIN new technique: cycling together--------------------

meta_data_combined <- meta_data_combined %>%

    group = recode(cond, `0` = "high", `1` = "low")
  )
pb_cycling = is_cycling_custom_method2(times_combined, pb_combined, meta_data = meta_data_combined, time_units = "rad")

pb_phases_high = as.numeric(unname(unlist(pb_cycling_filt$acrophase_bulk_high)))
pb_phases_low = as.numeric(unname(unlist(pb_cycling_filt$acrophase_bulk_low)))

#Subset the pseudobulk and variance matrices so I can save time not running var_cycling on non-cycling genes.
pb_combined_subset = pb_combined[pb_cycling_filt$Gene_Symbols,]
var_combined_subset = var_combined[pb_cycling_filt$Gene_Symbols,]
stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(pb_combined_subset), rownames(var_combined_subset)))

var_cyclers = var_cycling_custom_method2(times = times_combined, 
    var_mat = var_combined_subset,
    mean_mat = pb_combined_subset,    
    phase_pb_high =  pb_phases_high,
    phase_pb_low =  pb_phases_low,
    meta_data = meta_data_combined,
    time_units = "rad")

bulk_thr_cutoff = 0.5  

df = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling_filt, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix = c("_var", "_pb")) %>% filter(partial_model_AIC> full_model_AIC) %>%
  filter((amplitude_bulk_high >= bulk_thr_cutoff) | (amplitude_bulk_low >= bulk_thr_cutoff))
  
# Identify column names
cols_high <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "_high$")]
cols_low  <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "_low$")]
cols_common <- setdiff(names(df), c(cols_high, cols_low))

# Create new dataframes
df_high <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(cols_common, cols_high)))%>%
  mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase_high - acrophase_bulk_high) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude_high,fund_amp_high,amplitude_bulk_high, mesor_bulk_high,  everything()) %>%

  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "_high$")) %>%

df_low <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(cols_common, cols_low))) %>%
  mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase_low - acrophase_bulk_low) %% pi) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude_low,fund_amp_low,amplitude_bulk_low, mesor_bulk_low,  everything()) %>%

phi_low = df_low %>%

             )
    }) %>%
    t %>%
    as.data.frame
colnames(phi_low) = c("G", "Ac", "theta", "phi")
phi_low_output = merge(phi_low, df_low, by = 0)
phi_low_output <- phi_low_output %>%
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "_low$")) %>%
  mutate(Source = "1")

phi_results_i <- bind_rows(phi_high_output, phi_low_output)



#----- plotting ------
jitter_width <- 0.15
jitter_seed <- 123 # A specific seed for reproducibility
color_palette <- c("0" = "skyblue", "1" = "salmon")

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(phi_results_i, aes(x = Source, y = phi*12/pi, fill = Source)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(
  aes(x = Source, y = phi*12/pi), 
  alpha = 0.4,
  position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
  ) +
  # Manually set the colors for fill and color aesthetics
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) +
  #Significance bar
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",         # Specify the statistical test
    comparisons = list(c("0", "1")), # A list of the pairs to compare
    label = "p.signif",             # Display significance levels
    label.y = 7, # Adjust vertical position of the bar
    tip.length = 0.02 # Length of the small vertical lines
  ) +
  # Add labels and a title
  labs(
    title = "Phi estimates CTL AD cycling together",
    y = "Phase Dispersion (hrs)",
    x = "Pathway stratification"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # The x-axis labels are sufficient
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )+
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0" = "CTL", "1" = "AD"))+
```
